subject: Number of dimentions does not match

messages.author: b88260f88b61b712
messages.subject: Number of dimentions does not match
parts:
• I am following along the code presented in the book "Spatial and Spatio-temporal Bayesian Models with R-INLA by Marta Blangiardo, Michela Cameletti. 
  • Datasets were found on the book's website: https://sites.google.com/a/r-inla.org/stbook/datasets  ( see the subsection Low Birth Weights in Georgia)  
The book presents the following snippet of code:

 formula.ST1 <- y ̃ f(ID.area,model="bym",graph=Georgia.adj) + f(ID.year,model="rw2") + f(ID.year1,model="iid") 
 lcs <- inla.make.lincombs(ID.year = diag(11), ID.year1 = diag(11)) 
model.ST1 <- inla(formula.ST1,family="poisson",data=data,E=E, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE), lincomb=lcs)


When I copy this into R, it will not run, because "data" must be replaced by the appropiate filename and path.
I took what I assume to be the correct dataset, "Lowbirthweight_births.csv," (found on the book website 
https://sites.google.com/a/r-inla.org/stbook/datasets ).  

However,  I continually encountered the error of the dimensions not matching (159 rows in the csv file vs 1488 from an unknown object) on the line highlighted below. I do not understand the problem, but
I believe it is either because of the data attribute highlighted below or because of the ID objects.

###my version below
library(INLA)
library(rgeos)
library(maptools)
library(spdep)

georgia<-read.csv("C:/Users/Michael Gao/Documents/LBWGeorgia_data/Lowbirthweight_births.csv", sep=";")


georgia.gen<-readShapePoly("C:/Users/Michael Gao/Documents/LBWGeorgia_data/co13_d00.shp")
temp<-poly2nb(georgia.gen)
nb2INLA("C:/Users/wz913947/Documents/LBWGeorgia_data/georgia.graph",temp)
georgia.adj<-paste(getwd(), "/georgia.adj", sep="")
read_graph<-inla.read.graph(filename="C:/Users/wz913947/Documents/LBWGeorgia_data/georgia.graph")
image(inla.graph2matrix(read_graph), xlab="x-axis", ylab="y-axis")

ID.area=factor(georgia$Counties)
ID.year=rep(1:11,length.out=159)
ID.year1 = ID.year

formula.ST1<- y~ f(ID.area, model="bym", graph=georgia.adj) +  f(ID.year, model="rw2") + f(ID.year1, model="iid")
lcs<-inla.make.lincombs(ID.year = diag(11), ID.year1 = diag(11))

model.ST1<-inla(formula.ST1, family="poisson", data=georgia, E=E, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE), lincomb=lcs)

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Number of dimentions does not match
parts:
the issue is that the response 'y' has only length 16

> with(georgia, str(y))
num [1:16] 0 30 60 90 120 150 180 210 240 270 ...


and it has to be length as the rhs of the model (159).

also, you may need to do

ID.area=factor(georgia$Counties)
ID.area=as.integer(ID.area)


ie add the second line

H
